description: HID Trecho Drenagem is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Incorporação da camada "drenagem" da base cartográfica vetorial na escala de 1/25.000 criada pela CPRM para o projeto "Cartas de Suscetibilidade a Movimentos Gravitacionais de Massa e Inundação: Município de Teresina-PI" de 2014. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Hidrografia (HID), ET-EDGV 3.0, inlandWaters, imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
